title: Scalar restriction comparison for consecutive constant quotient realizations
statement: Scalar restriction comparison for consecutive constant quotient realizations.

proof.text: The actual maps from A/I^(n+1) and A/I^(n+2) to the corresponding completion quotients are bijective by the proved quotient_map_bijective helper of ConstantAdicQuotientScalarComparison. Their consecutive square commutes on representatives. Localize its restriction-composition isomorphism and apply inverse-mate invertibility along the two coefficient equivalences.
Use constant_square_mate_isIso, the already proved specialization of constantRealizationDerivedScalarExtension to the pro-etale site, for the ordinary consecutive finite quotient ring map.

Naturality of pbcLevelConstantComparison for the consecutive quotient arrow identifies the square between the constant finite ring sheaves and pbcAdicRings. Compose pbcRestrictComp in the two directions, localize, and use inverse-mate invertibility along the finite coefficient equivalences.

Apply the proved inverseImage_mate_isIso helper of ConstantAdicQuotientScalarComparison to the consecutive coefficient arrow and W.hom composed with g. Expand each exact quotient realization with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and compose the four inverse-mate component isomorphisms, mapping them through the remaining functors. This gives exactly the displayed isomorphism for E′.

theorem constantAdicQuotient_realization_scalar_reduction
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (n : ℕ) (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1 + 1)))) :
    let q : (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
        (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1 + 1)) →+*
        (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1)) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right
        (I := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
        (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))
    let Rn := constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n
    let Rnp := constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d (n + 1)
    let T := pbcDerivedExtend ((adicTowerInverseImage (W.hom ≫ g)).map
      (pbcAdicQuotient X d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)))
    Nonempty (Rn.obj ((CategoryTheory.ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension q).obj E') ≅
      T.obj (Rnp.obj E'))
